description: Two attenuverters, each scaling and inverting a signal and adding a fixed offset to it

params.text: Scales that channel's input from x-1 through zero to x1, inverting it anti-clockwise of noon
Adds a fixed voltage to that channel after its attenuverter, -10V to 10V

inputs.text: The signal to be scaled and offset

outputs.text: That channel's input scaled by its attenuverter with its offset added, clamped to -10V to 10V
